Title: General availability: Azure Spring Cloud application health monitoring and end-to-end TLS/SSL

Body.Content:
As of October 20, the following functionality is now generally available in Azure Spring Cloud:

  • Monitor application lifecycle events using Azure Activity log and Azure Service Health (GA). Azure Spring Cloud now provides built-in tools to monitor the status and health of your applications. Learn more.

  • Enable end-to-end SSL/TLS (GA). Earlier this year we provided support for end-to-end SSL/TLS to secure traffic from an ingress controller to applications via HTTPS. This feature is now generally available. Learn more.
